prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized scar / wounded-land region marker. Flat app-icon geometry.
A jagged lightning-bolt-like zigzag shape running diagonally across
the icon, in a contrasting red or ember-orange palette color. Behind
it, the background is a muted neutral palette color (bone-grey or
pale cream) indicating damaged ground. The jagged shape is the
dominant element — aggressive angular geometry, not smooth.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, centered on a clean off-white canvas with generous padding, single bold icon silhouette readable at 16px. A stark jagged zigzag lightning-bolt shape — aggressive angular geometry with sharp acute points — runs diagonally across the center, rendered in vivid #FF0000 red as a thick filled vector shape. Behind it, a flat bone-grey rectangular ground tile in muted neutral cream anchors the composition as a secondary shape. The zigzag dominates: three to four hard-edged angular teeth, no curves, no softness. Flat bold color fills, crisp vector edges, strong red-on-cream contrast, zero gradients, zero texture, zero brushwork. Modern UI icon register, every angle deliberate and punchy, high contrast, fully readable at tiny scale.
